title: Staying On Fire for the Messiah
description: In this passionate and prophetic sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner teaches on the key to staying on fire for the Messiah and experiencing extreme prosperity in the midst of famine. You'll be challenged to live according to the economic status of the Kingdom of God, not the world, and learn how to tap into the revelation that God wants to prosper you extremely. Join Pastor Chris as he declares that it's time for God's people to enter into a season of unprecedented blessing and breakthrough!
